description: Stair calculator with IRC/IBC check — Stair layout from total floor-to-floor rise: number of risers, exact riser height (decimal and 1/16-in fraction), treads, total run, stair angle, stringer length and minimum 2x12 board, framing-square cut layout, IRC or IBC geometry code checks (max/min riser, min tread, nosing, optional headroom), 2R+T comfort rule and alternative riser counts. Params: total_rise (inches, or suffix like 9ft). Optional: code=irc|ibc, riser (target in), tread (run per step in), nosing, headroom (in). Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
